snippet.title: ♾️The official trailer for Version 1.10 "Golden Season" is now live!
snippet.description:
♾️The official trailer for Version 1.10 "Golden Season" is now live!
In this gilded season, travelers arrive with more than just their luggage.
They carry heavy, untold stories... and sins long in the making.
Rookie detective, ready yourself for the challenges ahead.
Together, let's brave the stormy nights and welcome the bright, clear dawn!

Version 1.10 of Infinity Nikki "Golden Season" goes live on September 28 (UTC-7)!
Get ready for new events, levels, interrogations, Sovereign challenges ...and so much more! Stylists, don't miss out on the excitement—dive in and explore!

—— 
The Coziest Open-World Game! 
Infinity Nikki Version 1.10 "Golden Season" launches globally on September 28 (UTC-7)! 

#InfinityNikki
